final: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark HAVING AVG(fillcount) IS NOT NULL), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per), k1 AS (SELECT a, a - (SELECT m FROM b1) AS e1 FROM per WHERE a > (SELECT m FROM b1)), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill_qty, AVG(e1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(a - (SELECT m FROM b2)) AS avg_second_excess FROM k1 WHERE a > (SELECT m FROM b2)
